notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Attribute Scope Advisory path. The registry compares calculated scope for known object instances after committed region changes, update-region association changes, and ordinary or regional subscription changes; only active ordinary declarations or active overlapping regional triples make an attribute in scope, while passive state remains retained without arranging a scope advisory. The adapter queues official callbacks after releasing runtime locks, and callback entry rechecks current scope to suppress stale work. The test enables the per-federate switch and proves both HLA_IMMEDIATE and HLA_EVOKED delivery, one callback per changed attribute set, and stale queued-transition suppression for all three transition sources. The Lab's at-most-one candidate statements combine region modification with association; this contract now exercises the known-object region, association, and subscription transition sources while default-region behavior remains separate. Default-region synthesis, relaxed DDM, timestamped/retraction behavior, ownership transfer, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, protected review, and conformance remain separate scope.
